messages:
kevin: Heads-up: planning a quiet-window deploy tonight for runtime v2.4.1 (minor perf fixes). Target window 01:30-02:30 UTC. Canary -> staged ramp. Need router header compatibility and console parsing handshake. tagging @olivia @sanjay

olivia: on it. will coordinate console opt-in flags. do we have a gating telemetry list?

sanjay: router note: were doing an incremental header shift using x-rw-model (legacy still allowed). Router will accept both for 45m post-ramp. will seed 0.5% traffic for handshake.

kevin: telemetry gate: runtime_infer_p95 < 240ms, gen_error_rate < 0.7%, no KV eviction surge > 2x baseline. If any gate trips during canary -> immediate pause + rollback to v2.4.0 pinned. Ops to watch 5xx surge.

tara: deploy-bot preflight: infra quotas ok, canary pool healthy, migrations: none. console reported slight schema extension for structured metadata. @olivia please confirm console tolerance plan.

olivia: console plan: feature-flag rollout -> 01:35 expose v2 metadata header, 01:45 15% UI traffic, 01:50 enable for canary route. I'll paste runbook once I finish. also adding graceful-parse mode to ignore unknown meta fields for 20m.

deploy-bot: preflight passed. scheduling canary start at 1725510010. canary = 1% eu-cluster. will emit metrics to #prod-telemetry.

kevin: rollback thresholds for ops:gen_error >= 1% sustained for 4m OR p95 > 320ms for 2m -> rollback. Use cloudctl pin command in runbook. tara will own the pin.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. will set alerts: "runtime_gen_error_rate > 0.7% for 4m" and "runtime_p95 > 320ms for 2m". SEV2 page if triggered.

deploy-bot: canary metrics @+3m: tokens/sec 900, gen_errors 0.15%, p95 200ms, kv_evictions nominal. no gate tripped.

kevin: run quick canary smoke: sample 25 prompts + structured parse check + rerank smoke. olivia/sanjay coordinate header-swap smoke (0.25% with new header, 0.75% legacy).

sanjay: header-swap started at 1725510028. initial mismatch rate ~0.05% on optional meta field. tagging @olivia.

olivia: pushed tolerance patch to console to accept the extra meta key for now. note added to release notes and to runbook: follow-up to reconcile schema.

deploy-bot: canary @+10m: tokens/sec 1120, gen_errors 0.4%, p95 225ms. within telemetry gate.

kevin: good. plan staged ramp: 5% at 01:50 UTC, 30% at 02:05 if healthy. Callout: keep header compatibility for 1hr after final ramp. rollback pin command (in runbook):
cloudctl runtime pin --service runtime --version v2.4.0 --reason "canary breach: auto-pin"
tara: noted. I will execute pin if thresholds breached and post timestamped note in release notes.

ops-oncall: watching KV eviction metric and correlation to p95. will escalate if correlation found.

kevin: any last blockers before 5% at 01:50?

olivia: console ready. flags staged.

sanjay: router config good. keeping compatibility window.

tara: rollback playbook complete, release notes updated with canary-blocker entry and postmortem template.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramps: 5% at 1725510180, 30% at 1725510300. Notifying #eng-releases #prod-telemetry #ops.

kevin: thanks all. Ill watch first 20m and then approve wide rollout. :thumbsup:
